2) Canonical subprocessor roster (cloud providers, analytics, CDNs) and where EU data is hosted.
3) Primary security contact for the vendor security questionnaire and procurement steps for an MSA + DPA.

- Redwood: send our Vendor Security Questionnaire and a short evidence checklist (SOC 2, encryption at rest detail, logging/audit window).
- Schedule a 30-min security deep-dive for next week (suggest Wed/Thu morning PT) to walk technical data flows.
